transcript: AI just put government websites in danger, and Japan's Prime Minister told every business to fix their website tonight or shut it down. Even in US, the NSA and FBI said the same. Let me tell you what's really happening. Most of the websites you use every day run on something called PHP. Think of it as the engine working behind the scenes, quietly pulling your name, your number, and your address from a website's database. Now, security researchers using AI from OpenAI and Google found two bugs hiding inside this engine. The technical term is remote code execution, which simply means a hacker could send one crafted request and take over the whole website without needing any password. And this bug had been sitting there for more than 10 years. The fix was supposed to come out quietly, but the details leaked a day early. That's why governments in France, the Netherlands, and Finland switched off their own websites before hackers could get in. But here's the thing: this isn't a one-off. Japan has reported more than 600 cyberattacks this year, and its cyber agency confirmed hackers are using AI to find weak spots. And in France, hackers even took over the fridges of 350 supermarkets and heated them up to 50°C. Now here's the scary part. Earlier this year, Anthropic and OpenAI locked away their most powerful hacking AI because it was too dangerous. Just a few months later, a free open-source model from China called GLM 5.3 is almost as good. So what can you actually do? First, stop relying only on SMS OTPs and use an authenticator app or a passkey instead. Second, delete the apps you don't use because every app holding your number is one more door for hackers. In security, this is called reducing your attack surface. Third, set a secret code word with your family because AI can now clone your voice from a short video. And if you run a business website, ask your developer today if your PHP is updated. This time, AI found the bug before the hackers did. Next time, the hackers might find it first. I share such important updates daily inside my free WhatsApp community, so click the link in bio to never miss them.
